title: Sickle-cell gene arises (malaria shield)
place: Sahara, during the Green Sahara wet phase
summary: Genome analysis points to a single origin of the sickle-cell variant about 7,300 years ago in the then-green Sahara. One copy gives substantial protection against deadly malaria.
why: A classic case of disease shaping human genes, with a cost: two copies cause sickle-cell disease.

notes.problem: Single genome-model date ('is thought to have originated ... around 7,300 years ago'); genetic origin dates are model estimates and this one is contested.
